text: If a, b, c are three mutually perpendicular vectors of equal magnitude, prove that (a+b+c) is equally inclined with vectors a, b and c.

text: A farmer has fertilizer type A (10% nitrogen, 6% phosphoric acid) and type B (5% nitrogen, 10% phosphoric acid). At least 7 kg each of nitrogen and phosphoric acid is required. modelAnswer: Let x kg of A and y kg of B be bought. Nitrogen constraint: 0.10x + 0.05y ≥ 7 ⇒ 2x+y ≥ 140. Phosphoric acid constraint: 0.06x + 0.10y ≥ 7 ⇒ 6x+10y ≥ 700 ⇒ 3x+5y ≥ 350. Z at (0,140)=1120; Z at (50,40)=250+320=570; Z at (350/3,0)=1750/3≈583.3. Minimum Z=570 at x=50, y=40.
